download_mechanism: official CME FedWatch CSV download in an interactive browser
semantic_mapping: Probability that the target range after the 2026-09-16 FOMC meeting is 375-400 bps; with the pre-meeting target at 350-375, this is the +25 bp Polymarket outcome.
availability_rule_for_research: Date-only historical rows become usable at 12:00 UTC on the next calendar day.
caveats: The CSV exposes a date but no historical intraday publication timestamp.
The next-day-noon availability rule is conservative and intentionally discards same-day use.
The file is a downloaded historical vintage and does not prove what an earlier download would have contained.
Current page probabilities can be many hours old and are not automatically actionable against a live book.
